items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did a lot of things, Bernard Purdie and Richard Tee.

ctx.x: What caught my eye is the drummer. You see Bernard Purdie playing some of these – then you’ve got Richard Tee.
I did a lot with them. Not just this here. That realm of rock-and-roll, rhythm­ and-blues. We did a lot of things, Bernard Purdie and Richard Tee. What was the guitar player?
